text: Standing in front of this glass-walled room and the vibrant display labeled R+D, I feel a strong sense of curiosity and anticipation. The polished, modern environment fills me with wonder about human innovation and how we shape and are shaped by our surroundings. The texts and screens hint at stories of progress and collaboration, inviting me to reflect on the convergence of knowledge, technology, and creativity. There is an undercurrent of excitement—a luminous potential for discovery in this thoughtful, almost futuristic space.
